text:
Market Wave is long-only spot — there is no built-in hedge leg; drawdowns in sustained sell-offs come from accumulated coin inventory and sizing choices.

Exchange whitelist: the engine only arms on supported venue tickers; if the chart symbol is unsupported, the user will see no trades regardless of thresholds.

Liquidity / gap risk: bar-close logic ignores intra-bar wicks unless tick mode is enabled; gap opens can fill away from the envelope reference the user sees visually.

Pyramiding: multiple entries can stack; aggressive sizing plus shallow entry thresholds can concentrate exposure quickly — monitor effective cash and open notional on screenshots.

Invalidating conditions: regime filter enabled but price never breaks trend bands (signals stall); static price filters set inside current range (permanent block); date window accidentally set in the past/future; minimum notional blocking clips on small accounts.
